name: 05_token_bucket_cap_and_backwards_time
description: Capacity 2 refilling 5 tokens/sec, full at t=0. Long idle to t=100 would refill 500 tokens but the cap holds it at 2: two admits succeed, the third is denied. Then a backwards time reading (t=50 < last=100) refills nothing — never a refund — so it stays denied. Deterministic on both cores.
